Short title and commencement

THE TAX LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
THE TAX LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. XXXI OF 1962
[31st May, 1962]
An Ordinance further to amend certain tax laws
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may be called
the Tax Laws (Amend ment) Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of certain enactments

THE TAX LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
THE TAX LAWS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. XXXI OF 1962
[31st May, 1962]
An Ordinance further to amend certain tax laws
2. Amendment of certain enactments.-(1) The enactments specified in
the Schedule below, hereinafter referred to as the said enactments, shall be
amended in the manner specified in the fourth column thereof.
(2) Any rule, regulation, order
or appointment made, any notification issued, any licence granted, any
instruction or direc tion given or any other thing done or any action taken or
any proceedings commenced by the Central Government before the commencement of
this Ordinance under any provision of the said enactments wherein for the words
"Central Government" the word "Board" or words
"Central Board of Revenue" or "Chief Customs-authority"
have been substituted by this Ordi nance, shall be deemed to have been made,
issued, granted, given, done, taken or commenced by the Central Board of
Revenue or, as the case may be, the Chief Customs-authority under the said
provisions as amended by this Ordinance and shall have effect accordingly.
